summary: Verified the 'Technique & Positioning' feature card layout on the Home page. The technique-chart.jpg image is now rendered as a visible, opaque image occupying the top portion of the card, with the overline/heading/paragraph text stacked below it. No overlap, no bento-grid breakage, hero and footer render correctly, no page errors.

issues: Image intrinsic ratio (1080x1881, portrait) makes the card very tall (~1369px) at 666px width; image alone occupies ~1158px. Consider adding a max-height (e.g., 520px) on .card--feature img with object-fit:cover to keep the bento grid more balanced. Not blocking — text is still fully legible beneath the image.

console_errors: net::ERR_FAILED (from intentional lenis route abort during testing — not a real site error)

action_items: Optional: cap .card--feature img height (e.g., max-height: 520px) to keep the bento grid visually balanced — the portrait chart currently makes the card significantly taller than its neighbours.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout requirement fully met: image on top, text below, no overlap, no watermark.
Consider constraining image height to preserve bento grid proportion on desktop.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site tested via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Lenis CDN must be route-aborted ('**/lenis*') for programmatic scroll to work. Feature card at [data-testid='feature-technique'] now has an above a .in text block; verified via computed styles and card screenshot.
